summary.intent: Run the GSD manager command center for the CipherBox project to discuss, plan, and execute phases 42–44 (API unpin integrity, FUSE write durability, IPNS conflict handling) — three UAT gap-closure phases from PR #484, targeting completion of milestone v1.1.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 fully closed (8 plans, 3 waves, code review, verification, todos archived, PROJECT.md updated). Phase 43 fully executed (8 plans across 6 waves including a gap-closure sub-loop), re-verified, UAT file created for 4 runtime items, phase branch rebased. Phase 44 discussed, planned (4 plans), and ready for execution at transcript end.

repo: Kubo v0.40 runs with the `server` profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72); it broadcasts provider records for every pinned CID to the public DHT, making all CIDs discoverable without authentication.

POST /ipfs/unpin was authenticated by JwtAuthGuard only with open Web3Auth signup — the handler never read req.user, passing the CID directly to Kubo pin/rm. Any account holder could destroy another user's pinned content.

Writable-share saves silently drop prunedCids without unpinning (shared-write.ts:450) — there is no legitimate cross-user unpin flow; the only cross-user unpin path is the attack vector fixed in Phase 42.

No .prettierignore existed before this session — prettier was silently mangling planning docs, GSD workflow markdown, and VALIDATION.md regex tables (a pipe in a table cell was rewritten as a table column separator).
The `pending_unpins` outbox table has no user_id — it is a global CID-keyed outbox, not per-user, intentionally matching the design decision that BYO advisory rows count equally.

pnpm/jest flag forwarding bug: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` silently breaks because pnpm inserts `--` and jest treats the pattern flag as a positional regex. Correct form: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`

1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git Bash calls; signing failures manifest as 'fatal: failed to write commit object' and require restarting the 1Password desktop app.

Windows winfsp cross-compilation (`cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp`) fails on macOS due to pre-existing issues in windows-future and winfsp-sys registry crates — unrelated to Phase 43 changes; `cargo check` is the correct gate on macOS.

Phase 43's Windows write path (write_ops.rs) had a spurious `spawn_journal.remove` call after per-file IPNS publish success, diverging from the macOS CR-08 behavior. This was caught only during re-verification after gap closure and required an out-of-band fix commit.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fired a global `ipfsProvider.unpinFile` without ownership check — this was the second cross-tenant unpin surface beyond the main unpin endpoint. Fixed by rerouting through guardedUnpin in plan 42-05.
shared-write.ts save path drops prunedCids list but never calls unpin — means writable-share version pruning silently leaks quota. Deferred as a future improvement, not in scope for Phase 42.

guardedUnpin added: uses pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) to serialize per-CID operations, transactionally deletes row + checks refcount + inserts pending_unpins outbox entry, then calls Kubo pin/rm post-commit as best-effort. Cross-user attempts emit audit metric without error response.

Had `spawn_journal.remove(&journal_entry_id)` after per-file IPNS publish success in the background upload thread — this is the orphan window that CR-08 was meant to close. macOS path (plan 43-06) already removed it; Windows path diverged and needed a separate fix commit after re-verification.

Full rewrite in plan 43-01: added JournalOp enum (UploadFile|MkdirPublish), JournalEntry, JournalEntryStatus, and WriteQueue with put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay. The journal fsync-before-ack ordering is enforced in handle_release at line 844 (journal.put) → 892 (cleanup) → 894 (reply.ok) → 904 (spawn).

workflow: cleanup-wave merge helper must always run from the repo root — running it from inside an agent worktree causes false `base_mismatch` errors because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.

cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report `branch_mismatch` on a second run, aborting the entire run. Workaround: write a reduced manifest containing only the remaining unmerged entries.
Worktree cruft (untracked node_modules, .husky/_ shim) blocks merge operations — clean these before running cleanup-wave.

gsd commit helper returns `'committed': false` as a false negative even when the commit landed. Always verify with `git log` rather than trusting the helper result; never blind-retry a commit based solely on the helper response.
Plan checker warnings that are mechanical citation fixes (e.g. missing `D-07:` literal in a must_haves section) can be applied directly with Edit rather than spawning a full planner revision cycle.
openapi.json formatting drift from `nest build` side-effects (500+ line whitespace-only changes) should be restored with `git checkout --` before wave merges to avoid polluting the merge diff.
A merge that leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed) can be concluded with `git commit --no-edit` — no need to abort and redo.

friction: Session quota limits hit 3 times mid-execution, interrupting live wave tracking and requiring manual continuation prompts each time.
1Password SSH signing failures ('fatal: failed to write commit object') required restarting the desktop app mid-session; all subsequent git calls needed `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true`.
Planner agent socket error after writing plans 01-03 required a filesystem fallback: verifying partially-written plans on disk and spawning a continuation planner for the remaining plans.
cleanup-wave not being idempotent caused cascade failures when retrying a partially-completed merge run — required manually constructing reduced manifests.
cleanup-wave cwd dependency caused false base_mismatch errors when mistakenly run from inside a worktree rather than the repo root.
No .prettierignore existed — prettier corrupted a regex in VALIDATION.md (pipe in table cell) before the issue was caught; required both creating .prettierignore and a manual Edit fix.
gsd commit helper false negatives wasted time on unnecessary verification and nearly caused double-commits.
zsh multi-glob rm (`rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules`) aborts entirely if any glob path doesn't exist — required using single explicit paths.
Accidental user keystrokes ('touring wyatt web bossy' sent twice) interrupted execution flow mid-wave.
Windows winfsp CR-08 alignment bug was missed during initial execution and only caught during re-verification after gap closure, requiring an out-of-band fix commit outside the normal wave structure.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed due to the gate requiring a literal `D-07:` string citation in the plan's must_haves section — the plan addressed the decision without citing it by label.
open_items: Phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling) planned and ready but execution not started at transcript end — 4 plans written, pattern map committed, awaiting execute-phase invocation.
Phase 42 SECURITY.md is missing — `/gsd:secure-phase 42` was flagged in the close-out routing but not executed during this session.

Phase 43 has 4 UAT items requiring runtime testing (written to 43-UAT.md): crash-recovery replay on mount, WriteParked tray notification, journal fsync EIO propagation, and WinFsp Windows build integration test.
Writable-share prunedCids leak: shared-write save path drops version CIDs without unpinning, silently leaking quota for write-share participants. Deferred to a future phase.

BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring: the server-side fix makes BYO semantics correct for free ('not pinned' is swallowed), but proactive client-side unpin calls via the BYO provider interface are not wired. Deferred.

Rust FUSE merge parity: the IPNS merge logic (three-way merge with baseChildren param) is a TypeScript/SDK concern in Phase 44 — Rust FUSE parity for the same conflict handling was explicitly deferred.
Pending-uploads UI: a full UI showing parked/failed uploads with retry controls was noted as a future improvement during Phase 43 discussion; only the tray notification was implemented.
